summary: Changes since sdk==0.4.5 release(sdk-py): 0.4.6 ( #9214 ) fix(sdk-py): percent-encode thread_id and assistant_id in thread stream requests ( #9213 ) release(langgraph): 1.2.13 ( #9205 ) chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/sdk-py with 5 updates ( #9149 ) chore(deps): bump urllib3 from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0 in /libs/sdk-py ( #9134 )
body:
Changes since sdk==0.4.5

- release(sdk-py): 0.4.6 ( #9214 )

- fix(sdk-py): percent-encode thread_id and assistant_id in thread stream requests ( #9213 )

- release(langgraph): 1.2.13 ( #9205 )

- chore(deps): bump the minor-and-patch group in /libs/sdk-py with 5 updates ( #9149 )

- chore(deps): bump urllib3 from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0 in /libs/sdk-py ( #9134 )
summaryZh: LangGraph SDK 发布 0.4.6 版本，主要修复了在线程流请求中对 thread_id 和 assistant_id 进行百分比编码的问题，并更新了相关依赖库，提升了 SDK 的兼容性与运行稳定性。

aiReview.reasonZh: LangGraph SDK 的更新修复了关键的 API 请求编码问题，对智能体服务的稳定性有直接影响。
